a. 
__1 (At the end of certain comp.) Celebrated, famous, renowned, skilled in; तेन वित्तश्चुञ्चुप्चणपौ [[P. V. 2. 26.]] अक्षर°, चार° &c. रामोऽपि मायाचणमस्त्रचुञ्चुः [[Bk. 2. 32.]] 
-ञ्चुः The musk-rat or shrew. 
__2 A mixed caste born of a Brāhmaṇa father and Vaideha female; मेदान्ध्रचुञ्चुमद्गूनामारण्यपशुहिंसनम् [[Ms. 10. 48.]]
A game played with tamarind seeds instead of dice.
